question: Is the head-current module-level live output enough to merge this Claude CLI model-routing change, or should the contributor provide real configure/model-picker or Claude CLI selection proof first?
rationale: The code path is narrow and source-supported, but repository policy treats provider routing, auth setup, and session context behavior as proof-sensitive, and this read-only review cannot exercise the subscription-backed Claude CLI path.

options.title: Require real CLI proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a terminal screenshot from the latest head showing configure/model-picker output or actual Claude CLI selection with Fable 5 before merge.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the module-level live output and own the risk that the subscription-backed Claude CLI path was not exercised.

options.title: Merge after reconciling overlap
options.body: If proof is accepted and this PR lands, close or retarget the overlapping context-window refactor so the Fable resolver change is not duplicated.
